subject: 👋 Welcome to the University — Your Onboarding Plan
body:
Dear $staff_name,

Welcome to the University! Your onboarding plan has now been activated and the first set of tasks is waiting for you in the HR portal.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ONBOARDING DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Staff ID:        $staff_id
Start Date:      $start_date
Department:      $department
Line Manager:    $line_manager
Template:        $template_name
Assigned By:     $assigned_by
Due By:          $due_date
Assignment ID:   $assignment_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT TO EXPECT IN WEEK ONE

$task_summary

NEED HELP?

  • Log into the HR portal to see the full task list, owners, and deadlines.
  • Your line manager and HR partner have been copied — feel free to reach out.
  • IT credentials, building access, and payroll setup are tracked on the same plan.

We are delighted to have you on board.

Kind regards,
Human Resources
